title: Screen assertions
description: Firstlight methods added to NativePHP's Native::test() harness, and the make:firstlight-screen options.

blocks.text:
FirstlightUI\Testing\ScreenAssertions::register() adds the methods below to
NativePHP's Native\Mobile\Testing\TestableComponent, the object returned by
Native::test() and Native::visit(). They read the most recently published
Element Tree. Interactions send the event type and callback id that the
Firstlight iOS and Android renderers send, then re-render the screen as the
harness does after tap() or input().

NativePHP's own methods are unchanged and work on Firstlight controls. These
include input(), tap(), toggle(), check(), set(), assertSee(),
assertSet(), and assertElement(). For example, input('email', ...) types
into a Text Field bound with native:model="email".

A field target is either an element ref or the property name in the
element's native:model binding. A List row is identified by its exact
headline.

blocks.label: field($target)
blocks.text: Contract: Returns the wire node for the target, or fails.

blocks.label: assertFieldError($target, $message = null)
blocks.text: Contract: The field's published error is not empty and, when given, equals $message.

blocks.label: assertNoFieldError($target)
blocks.text: Contract: The field's published error is empty.

blocks.label: assertHasErrors($keys)
blocks.text: Contract: The screen's ValidatesFields MessageBag has each key. ['email' => 'message'] also requires that message.

blocks.label: assertHasNoErrors($keys = null)
blocks.text: Contract: The bag is empty, or has none of the given keys.

blocks.label: choose($target, $value)
blocks.text: Contract: Chooses the option whose stable value equals $value (compared as a string) in a Select, Segmented, Pill Group, or Choice Group. Fails when no option has that value, or the option is disabled or cannot be chosen. A Select option that is already selected cannot be chosen.

blocks.label: listItem($headline)
blocks.text: Contract: Returns the first List Item node with that headline, or fails and lists the headlines.

blocks.label: assertListItem($headline, $matcher = null)
blocks.text: Contract: A row exists. $matcher receives the wire node and must return true.

blocks.label: assertMissingListItem($headline)
blocks.text: Contract: No row has that headline.

blocks.label: assertListItemCount($count)
blocks.text: Contract: The tree contains exactly $count List Item rows.

blocks.label: pressListItem($headline, $action = null)
blocks.text: Contract: Presses the row, or the leading or trailing swipe action with the label $action. Fails for a disabled row.

blocks.label: assertConfirmationDialog($title = null)
blocks.text: Contract: A Confirmation Dialog is visible, optionally with that title.

blocks.label: assertNoConfirmationDialog()
blocks.text: Contract: No Confirmation Dialog is visible.

blocks.label: confirmDialog($title = null)
blocks.text: Contract: Sends the visible dialog's @press.

blocks.label: cancelDialog($title = null)
blocks.text: Contract: Sends the visible dialog's @dismiss.
Call FirstlightUI\Facades\Feedback::fake() before the screen sends Feedback.

blocks.label: assertFeedbackSent($message, $tone = null)
blocks.text: Contract: Feedback with that message, and optionally that FeedbackTone, was sent.

blocks.label: assertNoFeedbackSent()
blocks.text: Contract: No Feedback was sent.
register() also adds two expectations when Pest is loaded:
They pair with NativePHP's Native\Mobile\Testing\PestExpectations.
php artisan make:firstlight-screen {name} [--form] [--list] [--destroy] [--test] [--force]

blocks.label: none
blocks.text: Generates: App\NativeComponents\{name} extending FirstlightUI\NativeComponent, with render() returning native.{kebab-name}, and a Blade view with a title.

blocks.label: --form
blocks.text: Generates: A required name property, $rules, save() calling submit(), a Text Field bound with native:model, and a Save Button with :loading="$submitting".

blocks.label: --list
blocks.text: Generates: mount(), reload(), loadMore(), open(), and a listQuery() stub. A List bound to @refresh and @endReached renders $this->listItems.

blocks.label: --destroy
blocks.text: Generates: Includes --list. Adds requestDeletion(), cancelDeletion(), and deleteItem(); rows disabled by denies('delete', $item); a Delete swipe action; and a destructive Confirmation Dialog.

blocks.label: --test
blocks.text: Generates: tests/Feature/NativeComponents/{name}Test.php that uses Native::test() and these assertions.

blocks.label: --force
blocks.text: Generates: Overwrites existing files. Without it the command fails and writes nothing if any target exists.
The command is registered only when the application runs in the console.
